overview: In the Signature teaching of wind power basics, Costs is a load-bearing idea: understand it and much of the field clicks into place. Siting means height and clear exposure matter Grid tie means the interconnection process Together these ideas give the learner working intuition, not just vocabulary. The Signature presentation stresses why each principle holds, shows where it is used in real practice, and connects it forward to the Compounded material that follows.

methods: Install method: permitted tower, professional install, grid agreement

key_points: Siting: height and clear exposure matter
Grid tie: the interconnection process
Key vocabulary: PPA — the power purchase agreement; Cut-in — the starting wind speed.
Governing principle: Count full installed costs.
how_it_works: The Signature learner approaches Costs by anchoring it to what is already known: PPA (the power purchase agreement), then Cut-in (the starting wind speed). The working method is Install method: permitted tower, professional install, grid agreement Practice means rehearsing the idea until it can be reconstructed from scratch, which is exactly what the accompanying study program drills.
